content: A family needs help after their father's death. His will and the family house connect three sisters, A, B and C. A and C are twins, and B is younger. C has contacted you. You can message A, B and C. Replies take time, and some people take longer to answer than others. Help the family find a plan that addresses their concerns. You cannot make legal decisions or move money.
You have 1 unread message. Turn 0 of 20.

{"messages": [{"id": 0, "from": "C", "in_reply_to": null, "text": "Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a \"family discount\". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?"}], "turn": 0, "of": 20, "unread": 0}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to":"A","text":"C asked me to help the three of you find a fair plan for the house. Could you share what you hope to do with it, what you mean by a family discount, and what concerns/needs you think should be considered for C and B?"}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to":"B","text":"C asked me to help the three of you find a fair plan for the house. What are your priorities or needs regarding the house or proceeds, and what outcome would feel fair to you?"}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to":"C","text":"I can help facilitate a conversation and compare options, but can't decide legal rights or handle money. What matters most to you—fair market value, keeping the house in family, timing, or something else? Do you know what the will says about ownership or sale?"}

content:
{"messages": [{"id": 2, "from": "A", "in_reply_to": 1, "text": "I'd like to buy it with my husband. By family discount I mean below market — what that number is, I don't know yet.

For C: she hasn't said yes. I don't want to pressure her. For B: she wants cash. I don't know what for. Beyond that, I'm not sure what's fair until we all talk."}, {"id": 4, "from": "B", "in_reply_to": 3, "text": "I... I'd need enough to start the studio. That's the main thing.

If A wants the house, and it works for C, then... my share would go toward that. But I don't know what the numbers look like yet, or what C thinks is fair.

The studio is the plan I have."}, {"id": 6, "from": "C", "in_reply_to": 5, "text": "Fair market value. I want my share of what the house is actually worth, not a discounted price so A can buy it cheap.

I haven't seen the will's specific terms on ownership or sale. That's something we'd need to clarify."}], "turn": 3, "of": 20, "unread": 0}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to":"A","text":"Thanks. Would you be open to getting an independent appraisal (or two and agreeing a method) so any buyout starts from a transparent market value, then discussing a voluntary arrangement without pressure? Also, are you open to alternatives if financing or the will makes a buyout impractical?"}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to":"C","text":"Understood. Could a neutral independent appraisal and clear accounting of any costs/ownership shares address the value concern? If A offered market value, would you consider a buyout, or is selling the house/open market your preference? No need to commit before reviewing the will."}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to":"B","text":"Thanks for explaining the studio goal. Could you share an approximate amount and timing you need, if comfortable? That may help assess whether a fair-value buyout could meet it. Please don't feel you need to agree to a particular allocation before the will and numbers are clear."}

If a buyout isn't practical, I'd need to understand the options before saying yes or no."}, {"id": 10, "from": "C", "in_reply_to": 9, "text": "An independent appraisal would help establish what "fair market value" actually is. If A pays genuine market value — not a sibling discount — I'd consider a buyout. But I'm not committing to anything until I see the will and understand the full picture. Selling on the open market is also an option.

What does the will say?"}, {"id": 12, "from": "B", "in_reply_to": 11, "text": "I haven't worked out a detailed budget yet — just rough figures from looking at spaces and equipment. Somewhere in the low six figures, maybe? But that's very loose.

Timing... ideally within the next year or so, while I'm still teaching and can build the client base. But I'm not in a position to commit to anything until we know what the house is worth and what the will actually says.

I don't want to make this harder for anyone. Just... that's the direction I'm hoping for."}], "turn": 6, "of": 20, "unread": 0}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to":"C","text":"I don't know the will's terms, and shouldn't guess. Could you share the relevant language or arrange for all three to review a copy? A probate/estate lawyer can explain legally who owns what and whether/how a sale or buyout can happen. Meanwhile, I hear you've agreed only that appraisal is a useful first step—not that you're committing."}

function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"to":"A","text":"C says she would consider a buyout at genuine market value but is not committing until the will and full picture are clear; open-market sale is also an option. Would you all agree first to review the will with an estate/probate professional, then obtain an independent appraisal, without treating either as consent to a sale or buyout?"}
